card.name: Political and legal history narrative text
card.fires_on: Mixed words in encyclopedic passages about politics, government, law, war or scandal, such as 'On' before a date, digits inside numbers, 'by' after a committee, or 'Minister'. The common thread is the setting, not one word.

modes.label: Dates and numbers
modes.description: Digits or a date-opening 'On' in historical or political accounts.

modes.label: Government and inquiry wording
modes.description: Linking words or titles around committees, ministers and inquiries.

modes.description: Digits in article numbers in treaty or legal text.
